finding: The generated-hostname curl receipt requires curl >= 7.72.0 because %{json} was added in 7.70.0 but the required method metric was added in 7.72.0.
uncertainty: The curl build in the eventual authenticated checkout has not yet been observed.
A compatible version number does not by itself prove the packaged executable emits every required key; the preflight therefore also requires an observed key-presence probe.
design_implication: Run a no-network curl capability preflight before generated-hostname observation and reject the observation path when the executable is older than 7.72.0, the version command fails, or any required write-out key is absent.
claim_boundary: This proves only that retained version output and probe keys satisfy the capability contract; it does not prove network reachability, TLS success, deployment identity, route correctness, browser behavior, or audibility.
falsification_route: Run curl --version in the authenticated checkout and retain exact output and exit code.
Run a no-network write-out expansion probe and retain its parsed keys.
Reject the capability claim if curl is older than 7.72.0 or any required key is absent.
